name: smwgraphics-ueki-no-housoku-jingi-sakuretsu-nouryokusha-battle-inuyama-park-robert-stage
title: Ueki no Housoku: Jingi Sakuretsu! Nouryokusha Battle -  Inuyama Park (Robert Stage 1)
description:
I sure love converting BGs from games I've never heard of. This is the japanese version of Ueki no Housoku Jingi Sakuretsu! Nouryokusha Battle for the Game Boy Advance. Originally, this was ripped by OmniGamerX. I converted his rip for SMW usage. I had to remove one column of 8x8 tiles since I had no idea if it had any use. Overwrites bushes, diagonal pipes and 1 color gradient.
You should use either a patch that allows horizontal scroll speeds towards slow or set the Horizontal BG scrolling to None.
OmniGamerX needs credit.
